spec.description:
Autex Printed Lanes Baffle Plane combines an understated flattened plateau
profile with high-definition digital UV printing from the Acoustic Timber and
Surface Finishes collections. Hand-picked woodgrains and stone textures are
digitally applied using safe, water-based inks directly onto 12mm Cube polyester
felt. Featuring a rear air gap that boosts acoustic performance to NRC 0.80, it
installs quickly using an adhesive-free mechanical clipping system.
features:
Understated flattened plateau profile with realistic digitally
printed timber or stone finishes

High-definition print using safe,
water-based UV-cured ink without degrading acoustic performance

Rear air gap
cavity enhances low and mid frequency sound absorption (NRC 0.80)

Glue-free
mechanical clipping system ensures fast, clean, and mess-free installation

Lightweight and seismic-safe alternative to solid wood panelling or marble
fluting

Constructed from 100% polyester fibre with a minimum of 60% to 80%
recycled PET

Group 1 fire rating compliant with AS ISO 9705 - 2003 and
AS 5637.1

Modular 300mm width sections available in 2400mm and 2700mm
lengths
Certified Carbon Neutral product with third-party verified EPD
Moisture and mould resistant (ASTM G21-15 Growth Rating: 0)

install: Check wall substrate is plumb, flat, and dry

Inspect printed grain or
pattern orientation across all lanes prior to mounting

Fix horizontal
mounting clips or channel track to framing studs at 300mm vertical centres

Snap the printed folded Plane lanes onto mounting clips firmly without
adhesive

Align adjacent panels to ensure continuous woodgrain or stone
appearance

Trim bottom or top ends carefully using a fine-toothed saw on the
offcut side
selection_checklist:
Select print finish from Acoustic
Timber woodgrains or Surface Finishes palettes

Confirm wall height to
choose 2400mm or 2700mm lengths

Calculate wall width in 300mm increments (3
lanes per pack)

Confirm Plane flattened plateau profile suitability for
design aesthetic
Verify substrate framing supports mechanical clip mounting
limitations:
Indoor use only; avoid
wet areas or direct water exposure

Requires mechanical clip installation; do
not glue directly flat to wall

Handle carefully with clean gloves to prevent
scuffing the printed surface during install

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Printed Lanes Baffle Plane pairs an understated,
flattened linear plateau profile with high-definition digital UV printing of
natural timber grains and stone textures on 12mm Cube polyester felt. Sized
in 300mm wide modular sections with a glue-free clipping system that maintains
an acoustic air gap, it delivers high sound absorption (NRC 0.80) while
replicating architectural wood panelling. Rated Group 1 fire compliant and
certified carbon neutral with over 60% recycled PET, it provides a quiet,
sophisticated acoustic wall finish for commercial and educational spaces.
